- **Documented**: 4 of 4 modules carry an author's summary

3 requirements: 3 checked.
label: runtime
quotes: The client module hydrates island components in the browser, using a marker on DOM elements to avoid re-hydrating them and relying on React to render content into slots.
Runs a hydrate call; components rendered inside it read the server snapshot of external stores.
Islands defines the client/server-shared registry and encoding logic that lets interactive components be rendered server-side and selectively revived as hydrated islands in the browser.
Server-side rendering entry point that renders island components into HTML with their slot content, exposing a public operation for the runtime to generate server-rendered output.
